name: PHAR 5216
title: Dosage Forms I
description: Introduces the student to the principles of thermodynamics, ionic equilibrium, chemical kinetics and diffusion.  Application of these principles to formulation, stability and dissolution of a drug product, and release from the dosage form for optimum therapeutic outcome.  Required of entering graduate students in Pharmaceutics who do not have a Pharmacy background as well as those who do not pass the qualifying examination within the first year of the program.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
